question: Can occupancy on one distant shell predict the frozen #04 open 2x2x3 occupied-patch H1(F2)>0 event beyond local inventory/coordination/crystal strata and a strong packing/crystal shell predictor? One question, no other radius, target, model slate, or new data.
lineage: L20 validated release; disjoint bulk (chain_seed,chain_id) only. Native TRAIN order positions >=5120 at indices 9,0,8. Never use validation, TEST, index 6, reserved cold interiors, earlier native-TRAIN audit positions 4608:5120, or preparation seeds. After excluding non-bulk and cross-role lineage duplicates, take in order cold pilot 256, fit 3072, development 512, cold assessment 1024. Separate beta-zero control 1024 and prospective beta=2.711111111111 transfer 1024. Check all before reading outcomes. Historical generic use of TRAIN disclosed; not virgin configurations. Warm transfer stays sealed unless cold and hot pass.
exposure: First ledger #04 selected event after cold/warm/hot marginal development on native TRAIN first 256 and probed marginal pair-model prevalence on beta7 first 512 native VALIDATION parents using first 256 TRAIN to fit. Previous R=4 test forecast tripod versus T at matched cross coordination, NOT cubical H1. Previous #21 and #25 concern microscopic face letters. No new holdout claim for the selection of this motif. Check repository publications for this precise endpoint times shell, statistical units, and row lineage before running.
geometry: Reuse frozen topology_table and compare every entry to archived betti lookup; 142/4096 positive words. Axes z,y,x; fifteen_topology.PATCH + (0,0,-1); no periodic faces inside the 12-site complex. Only boundary information is the vacancy bits at 386 sites max(abs(r))=4 about the anchor, with minimum toroidal L1 distance 3 to any central-patch site. Any owner energy depends on a center and its 6 NN, diameter at most two. No hidden near halo in shell features. Registered 128 uniform anchors without replacement per parent using PCG64([260404,index,native_parent]); all estimands are anchor-weighted with uncertainty across intact parents.
nuisance: Exact occupied and A inventories. Coarsen number of internal occupied NN edges by floor(edges/2) and internal checkerboard vacancy imbalance by floor(abs(v_even-v_odd)/2). These are intercept/matching factors shared by all arms, not raw patch bits, graph rank, component count, location, label, chain id or anchor. Keep strata with beta0 theoretical conditional event probability [0.05,.95], and >=32 pilot occurrences and >=16 distinct pilot parents of each outcome. Freeze all such strata with no rescue. Estimand pertains to these overlap strata, not all patches.
preflight: Require distinct permitted lineage, previous direct comparison unspent, >=25% of all pilot origins and >=50% of pilot positive origins retained, at least 128 contributing pilot parents. Require projected 80%-power MDE <=0.001 nat/eligible on 1024 assessment parents for the outcome-only fixed +/-0.15-logit independent-sign precision diagnostic. Not a guarantee of actual post-fit precision. If any fail, stop before training. No radius/strata/margin change.
margin: 0.001 nat per eligible origin. Proper Bernoulli log score, probabilities clipped identically to [1e-7,1-1e-7]. At cold, same fixed hard learned model must exceed BOTH stratum-only intercept and strongest registered packing/crystal ensemble, with paired whole-parent 95% lower limits > margin. Both required (intersection-union). Report all absolute scores, differences, parent CI, 2.80*SE and baseline-conditional signal. On dev check support, learned code noncollapse and actual 1024-parent projected MDE for learned-vs-packing before opening cold. Minimum practical precision criterion <=0.001. No model selection by development; if inadequate retire as unresolved. No declaration of a universal null.
beta_zero: At beta zero conditional on identical patch inventory, patch pattern and distant shell are independent under sampling without replacement; conditioning on additional purely interior summaries preserves this. Exact P0(H1>0|stratum) from all compatible masks. Evaluate same frozen models on separate hot parents with no recalibration. Report outcome prevalence vs exact hypergeometric catalog, and residual (Y-P0(S)) times the learned-minus-packing logit as an association-only null; no criterion that the cold fitted probability itself be calibrated hot. Control passes if 95% parent interval for this residual association contains zero and lies within +/-0.001 nat/eligible, and unconditional prevalence agrees with exact finite-count expectation within 3 parent SE. No reassessment if failed.
transfer: Only after cold primary and hot control both pass, issue an unchanged prediction at beta 2.711111111111 on permitted disjoint bulk parents: same geometry, eligible strata, weights, encoders, intercepts and decoders; same requirement on both paired lower bounds >0.001. Require >=25% assessment anchors retained, >=50% positive retained and both observed outcomes across >=128 parents on each scored cohort. No other transfer; if cold/hot fails do not access transfer states. No new cavity campaign, even a pass establishes static conditional association rather than recurrence or a thermodynamic phase.
